newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Expeditors' EPS view up.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Expeditors' EPS view up.

text.p: --EVEREN Securities Inc said Tuesday it raised its EPS earnings estimates on Expeditors' International of Washington Inc to $1.85 from $1.70 for 1996 and to $2.30 from $2.04 for 1997.

--Analyst Kevin Silverman in a report said the action followed guidance on Monday from Expeditors' management that analysts' earnings estimates for the third quarter ended September 1996 were too low and were likely to fall in the range of $0.55 to $0.60.
--"We've raised our Q3 EPS estimate to $0.58 from $0.49 and our Q4 EPS estimate to $0.55 from $0.49," Silverman.
